title: Cutaneous Microthrombi and Purpura in Severe Sepsis
author: Emergency doc
caption: Clinical photograph showing cutaneous microthrombi and hemorrhagic purpura associated with disseminated intravascular coagulation in severe sepsis.

clinical_relevance: Illustrates severe systemic endothelial injury and coagulopathy in worst-case sepsis progression (CLIFF-044, p.3-5).
